packageRules.description: Pin GitHub Actions to immutable commit SHAs. A floating tag is a mutable reference to code that runs with repository credentials, which is the supply-chain hole this closes. Scoped to github-actions: npm packages already carry integrity hashes in the lockfile, so digest pinning there adds nothing.
Freeze the build-stack boundary. These are pinned deliberately and bumped only as part of a coordinated upgrade, not by routine automation.
Majors need a human. An automated major lands a breaking change on a branch nobody chose to upgrade.
One pull request for everything else. Ungrouped updates produce a pull request per dependency and the whole set gets ignored together.
